suggestedFields.prompt: What problem are you solving? Who is the user and what does the solution need to do?
Show your ideas and explain why you selected your final design.
Document what you manufactured and assembled. Explain any changes from your design.
Show how your program reads the sensor and controls the sound system.
Test your system systematically and record quantitative results.
What did the evidence tell you to change? Show the change and retest it.
Evaluate the final solution against each success criterion and reflect on your contribution.
